name: Yummy Country-Style Ribs
description: A flavorful and tender country-style ribs recipe marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, orange juice, and spices, then grilled to perfection.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all marinade ingredients except the ribs in a bowl. Mix well.
Place ribs in a shallow dish and cover with the marinade. Refrigerate for 24 hours, turning meat occasionally.
Remove ribs from marinade and place on barbecue grill. Cook over low heat for about 1 hour, brushing with marinade occasionally.
Close barbecue hood and continue cooking until done, about 15 minutes more.

keywords: country-style ribs, marinated ribs, BBQ ribs

_similar.name: Maple Glazed Ribs
_similar.description: A sweet and savory pork spare ribs recipe glazed with a maple syrup-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut ribs into serving-size pieces and place in a roasting pan. Cover and bake for 1½ hours or until tender.

Meanwhile, combine the Dijon mustard, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, orange juice, curry powder, garlic, ketchup, green onions, and soya sauce in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the ribs and pour the sauce over them. Bake uncovered for an additional ½ hour, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: maple glazed ribs, pork spare ribs, sweet and savory

_similar.name: Spareribs to Go
_similar.description: A versatile spareribs recipe that can be broiled or heated in a glaze sauce, perfect for make-ahead meals.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil spareribs, cut into serving pieces, in salted water for 1½ hours. Drain and place in a shallow dish.
Pour the glaze mixture (garlic and honey) over the ribs. May be frozen for later use.
To finish, remove ribs from the glaze and broil 6 inches from heat in the oven or barbecue until crisp. Alternatively, baste ribs and heat in the sauce.

_similar.keywords: spareribs, garlic honey glaze, make-ahead ribs

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Pork Chops with Dried Fruit
_similar.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring pork chops cooked with assorted dried fruits in a flavorful orange juice sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups assorted dried fruit (apples, peaches, pears, apricots, raisins)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil and cook pork chops until golden brown on each side, about 6 to 8 minutes per side. Remove chops to a plate.
Reduce heat, add 1 cup orange juice to the skillet, and scrape any browned bits from the pan. Bring to a boil.
Add the remaining orange juice, dried fruit, Worcestershire sauce, and allspice. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with a small amount of water or juice. Stir into the skillet and cook until the sauce thickens, about 15 minutes.
Return pork chops to the skillet and cook until heated through. Serve with rice or couscous.

_similar.keywords: pork chops, dried fruit, orange juice sauce, savory sweet dish
